The following events occurred in '''1000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*End of the [[New Sith Wars]] and the [[Republic Dark Age]].<ref name="NEC" />
*The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] are believed to be extinct following the [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] campaign.<ref name="ROT" />
*[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] takes "Rain" as his apprentice, dubbing her [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]].<ref name="ROT" />
*The [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] is established by Darth Bane.<ref name="POD" />
*Darth Bane, along with Darth Zannah create the [[Order of the Sith Lords]], thus continuing the legacy of the Sith.<ref name="ROT" />
*[[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] is elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="ROT" />
*The [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]].<ref name="ROT" />
*[[Hok/Legends|Hok]] and [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] were established as [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonies.<ref name="TEGASx">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], p. X</ref>
**[[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] [[Gran Protectorate Act/Legends|was established]] on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*The first settlers arrived on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]]. {{Circa}}<ref name="GATORW" />
*The [[Khommite/Legends|Khommites]] achieve a level of [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] technology far surpassing that of the rest of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].
*The [[Alsakan Tessent]] is carved to commemorate the [[Battle of the Ten Valleys]].
*[[Sapella]] enters an ice age. {{Circa}}
*''[[Baanu Miir]]'' is grown. {{Circa}}
*[[Ore/Legends|Ore]] and [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] mining on [[Umnub]] plays out {{Circa}}<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
*The [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] reaches its largest extent of twenty-eight colony worlds.
*The [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] had died out on [[Lehon/Legends|Lehon]] and were believed to be extinct.<ref name="POD" />
*A [[Dug-Gran conflict|war]] breaks out between the [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] and [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> {{Circa}}
